node.title: Nonzero tangent mismatches reduce to fixed-excess punctured GRS charts
node.statement: Let A=K+h and q_z=p_z-(c0+z c1) be a nonzero difference codeword for an exact-A witness S, with T the recovered-pair discrepancy support. If W=S\T and d=|W|, then P_W divides q_z, d<=K-1, and q_z/P_W has degree below K-d. On T, after scaling e0,e1 by P_W^{-1}, it agrees on A-d coordinates. Thus every mismatch enters a punctured GRS chart of dimension K-d, agreement A-d, invariant excess h, and error radius R-h. This is a per-witness reduction, not an aggregate over W.
